title: agentwatch record
description: A normalized agent activity record (tool call / behavior span).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent (TRACE-1). Additive in schema 0.2.0; absent on legacy records.

host.description: Originating host tag for fleet aggregation (M11 R13)

parent_session_id.description: Logical parent session for resumed/forked sessions (M9)

producer.description: Record provenance (M15 S26). Optional for backward compatibility: records written before this field are read as an inferred kind 'hook'. New records should set it.

workload_identity.description: SPIFFE/WIMSE workload-identity URI when the harness exposes one (IDN-1). A URI, never a secret.

credential_class.description: What kind of credential the agent acted under (IDN-1); a classification, never a value.

principal.description: On-behalf-of principal (IDN-1); hashed by default in metadata-only. Never secret material.

delegation_chain.description: On-behalf-of chain (IDN-1); principals hashed by default. Absent when not exposed.

response.description: Redacted tool result per privacy mode

record_phase.description: Pre/post-execution provenance for AAT (AAT-1). Additive in schema 0.2.0; absent on legacy records and read as 'unknown' — never inferred.

approval.description: Who authorized the call (M19 S14, legacy). Absent on legacy records and read as 'unknown'.

authorization.description: Authorization provenance v2 (M29 APV-1, PRD 49). Additive in schema 0.2.0; absent on legacy records and read from `approval` at read time (never written back).

environment.description: Metadata-only session-start snapshot: VCS revision, OS principal, harness/OS (M19 S16/S29). No env-var values.

truncated.description: Visible truncation marker when a pathological record exceeded a limit (M21 S36): {fields:[{field, original_bytes, rule}], record_bytes?}. Never a silent shortening.
